name: craft-php-guidelines
description: Craft CMS 5 PHP coding standards and conventions. ALWAYS load when writing, editing, reviewing, or discussing any PHP in a Craft plugin or module, even small edits, and when running ECS, PHPStan, or ddev craft make. Covers PHPDoc blocks (@author, @since, @throws chains), section headers (=========), class organization, naming (services, jobs, records, events, enums), defineRules(), beforePrepare() and addSelect(), MemoizableArray, DateTimeHelper vs Carbon, declare(strict_types=1), ?string nullables, early returns, CP Twig templates, form macros, Craft::t, ECS/PHPStan config, and the verification checklist.

findings.excerpt: When unsure about a convention, `WebFetch` the coding guidelines page for the authoritative answer.
- `WebFetch` on Craft docs or plugin README — for API reference
- **Verification gate:** `ddev exec --dir /var/www/html/vendor/{vendor}/{plugin} vendor/bin/pest --filter=SyncJobTest` green; `curl -X POST` with a valid signat
